content.title: ‘When I slice onions, onions cry’: Utahns remember legendary Chuck Norris jokes after family announces his death
content.text: SALT LAKE CITY (ABC4) — “Chuck Norris isn’t dead. We’re all dead and Chuck Norris is still on Earth.” This is just one of the many memes that are now frozen in time as fans remember the life of the long-loved actor, Chuck Norris. Norris, the famed martial artist turned actor, passed away on Thursday at 86 years old, according to a statement from his family. Known both for his double black belt in martial arts and his intensely fierce on-screen characters, Norris is eternalized in mainstream media as a “tough guy.” The mid-2000s transformed Norris into the into the newest version of a knock knock joke, as fans began to post extremely hyperbolic facts about him online. “Did you know that Chuck Norris doesn’t have a chin under his beard? It’s another fist.” This along with other “facts” quickly became viral memes, amplifying his legend to new generations and immortalizing him on the internet. In the hours after his death was announced, ABC4 took to the streets to ask Utahns to recite their favorite Chuck Norris jokes. The result: an abundance of chuckles: “When I slice onions, onions cry”- Chuck Norris “Chuck Norris doesn’t die, death Chuck Norrises” “Who’s going to hold down the world? Chuck Norris.” “Did you know that when Chuck Norris was born, the doctor didn’t slap him, he slapped the doctor.” “Chuck Norris isn’t dead. We’re all dead and Chuck Norris is still on Earth.” “Chuck Norris can pass an eye exam with his eyes closed.” “Children fear the boogeyman. But the boogeyman hides in the closet because he fears Chuck Norris.” “When Chuck Norris does a pushup, he doesn’t push himself up, he pushes the earth down.” “A cobra once bit Chuck Norris, and after five days of pain, the cobra died.” Whether it be his strength, mind, or body, the memes take his legend to a whole new level, and although Utah is sad to know that Norris has passed, they also know that his name will live on forever. “Time waits for no man, unless that man is Chuck Norris.” In honor of Norris, send us your favorite Chuck Norris joke or meme to our tipline.
